title: Sable and the Compass
author: Orsen Amberdale
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
